options.name: advertise_virtual_rmac
options.description: The advertise_virtual_rmac parameter lets BGP to use the VMAC with VIP as next-hop when advertising type-2 routes. Should be used together with advertise_pip parameter from cisco.nxos.nxos_bgp_address_family module.

options.name: global_ingress_replication_bgp
options.description: Configures ingress replication protocol as bgp for all VNIs. This is available on Nexus 9000 series switches running NX-OS software release 9.2(x) or higher.

options.name: global_mcast_group_L2
options.description: Global multicast IP prefix for L2 VNIs or the keyword 'default'. This is available on Nexus 9000 series switches running NX-OS software release 9.2(x) or higher.

options.name: global_mcast_group_L3
options.description: Global multicast IP prefix for L3 VNIs or the keyword 'default'. This is available on Nexus 9000 series switches running NX-OS software release 9.2(x) or higher.

options.name: global_suppress_arp
options.description: Enables ARP suppression for all VNIs. This is available on NX-OS 9K series running 9.2.x or higher.

options.name: host_reachability
options.description: Specify mechanism for host reachability advertisement.  A Boolean value of 'true' indicates that BGP will be used for host reachability advertisement. A Boolean value of 'false' indicates that no protocol is used for host reachability advertisement. Other host reachability advertisement protocols (e.g. OpenFlow, controller, etc.) are not supported.

options.name: interface
options.description: Interface name for the VXLAN Network Virtualization Endpoint.

options.name: multisite_border_gateway_interface
options.description: Specify the loopback interface whose IP address should be used for the NVE Multisite Border-gateway Interface. This is available on specific Nexus 9000 series switches running NX-OS 7.0(3)I7(x) or higher. Specify "default" to remove an existing gateway config.

options.name: source_interface
options.description: Specify the loopback interface whose IP address should be used for the NVE interface.

options.name: source_interface_hold_down_time
options.description: Suppresses advertisement of the NVE loopback address until the overlay has converged.

options.name: state
options.description: Determines whether the config should be present or not on the device.
